StructuredXMLResume.ExecutiveSummary:
Around 7+ years of experience in the IT Industry and 5+ years of experience in the Analysis, Design, Development, Deployment and Maintenance of BPM and BRE applications using the Pega Rules Process Commander (PRPC 5.x/6.x) tool.
Expertise in working with solution frameworks like CPM, CPM HC, SmartBPM, which represent various business verticals.
Good knowledge of organizational hierarchy and hence involved in requirement gathering along with business analysts to better understand end user requirements and various scenarios.
Expertise in developing and managing Workflows, Class structures design, developing User Interface (UI), creating various Flow actions, interpreting Tickets, complex flow shapes for business scenarios, Activities, activity step methods, Decision maps and Decision rules.
Excellent understanding of various types of Rules like Product rules, Correspondence rules, Integration rules and Ruleset management, and associated tools such as export & import tools.
Excellent knowledge on using debugging and performance tools like Clipboard, Tracer, Performance Analyzer (PAL) and System Management Application (SMA).
Hands on 3 yrs of experience in Java2EE, EJBs, Servlets, JSP.
Excellent real-time knowledge on AGILE and SCRUM methodologies, Object Oriented Programming (OOP), Relational Database (RDBMS) and Service Oriented Architecture (SOA), CRM.
Excellent knowledge of developing Rich UI, CSS, Skins, Screen Layouts using JSP's, HTML and AJAX.

PositionHistory.Title: Pega Systems Consultant
PositionHistory.Description: Zurich Insurance Schaumburg, IL Nov 2013- Present Pega Systems Consultant Pega Senior System Architect Responsibilities: Installed the PRPC version 6.3 and solution framework Pega Insurance into the PRPC, which involved contribution from various teams such as Database and System Administration. Involved in business requirement gathering along with the business analyst for the application UW Work Flow Management application. Developed new portal layouts which served new roles in the organization, in addition to the pre- packaged layouts. Involved in enabling security and access control to the application by creating different levels of access to various business users and developers i.e access groups, work groups, access roles. Developed the code in branch rule versions which helps in parallel development in multiple teams. Designed and developed high level class structure in PRPC like class groups, work classes based on the organizational hierarchy. Designed and implemented user interfaces using Sections, Harness and HTML stream rules. Created specialized rulesets which served as containers for specific rule types. Used Clipboard and tracer tools to navigate through flows along with the work objects and trace the results. Performed integration by developing rules pertained to rule-connect and rule-service. Major tasks involved integrating with SQL databases to fetch data and with SOAP/Webservices to review particular data. Developed Correspondence rules to intimate the customers about their account balance, any disputes, offers available status through email or fax messages. Developed product rules to migrate data instances and rulesets from development to User Acceptance Testing & Performance environment when needed. Involved in List and Summary view reports and documentation Migrated the code into most recent version of PRCP Pega 7.

PositionHistory.Title: Pega Senior System Architect
PositionHistory.Description: MasterCard, O'Fallon, MO Sep 2012 - Mar 2013 Pega Senior System Architect Payment Processing Description: Implemented PRPC tool for intelligent automation of Payments Processing and resolve payments exceptions. The project includes major solution frameworks like SmartBPM and Smart Adjust. While Smart Adjust provided opportunity to automate the decision-making and work processing involved in error and exception management that occur during processing cycle, with SmartBPM we uniquely integrate business rules and policies. Our project was to include these two frameworks as the backbone for the application and develop new business rules and classes and apply security to it. Responsibilities: Involved in the design of class Structure, Properties, Activities and Service rules Involved in integration to Filenet SOAP service to fetch the claims records. Developed Flows and activities. Reviewed the technical document and supported development to achieve their goals. Modified technical design documents and requirements documents after final review. Actively involved in the User Interface design and coding. Creation of Declarative expressions for a value change on the properties. Creation of validation rules to implement business logic validation. Implementation of decision tables, Decision Maps and Declarative expressions. Creation of activities and steps for implementing core business logic. Testing and debugging using tracer and DB trace. Handled a Project upgrading PRPC version from 5.5 to 6.2. Used CPM Card framework which has specific features as per business requiremenst in building workflows as part of BPMS Project. Deliverables were implemented in Agile methodology. Interacted with clients to understand the business requirements. Modified the existing portal layouts, depends on the User roles, Privileges. Implemented Service Level Agreement rules to send the correspondence to external users. Environment: Java, J2EE, WebSphere 6.1, Pega PRPC 5.4SP1/5.4SP2, MQSeries, Web Services, XML, SOAP, AIX, Windows XP, Eclipse

PositionHistory.Title: Pega Senior Developer
PositionHistory.Description: Citibank, Sioux Falls, SD Feb 2011 - Sep 2012 Pega Senior Developer Dispute Servicing Manager: AP is responsible for managing current invoice, check request, and wire transfer workflow payment processes. The request document (paper document) is scannedonto a n/w sharing folder as an image with an agent running in the background. Depending upon the type of request the work object is created and is processed through the work flow. The project made use of a varied set of rules including declarative expressions, circumstance-qualified rules, service-soap, connect-soap, connect-sql, decision trees, decision tables etc. Responsibilities: Involved in installing Pega PRPC tools, helped system administrator in sorting out major installation issues. Involved in developing authentication solution through SSO (single sign-on) using LDAP server, and to configure custom authentication activity and web.xml as well. Involved in requirement gathering and analyzing them with system architect. Involved in security design for successful access control by assigning various access roles, groups to various business users upon their level of rule-usage. Created Classes, rule sets and designed simple workflows and sub flows. Developed Property rules, HTML rules, Embedded Pages and used them in activities. Created agents which will run in the background to generate daily, weekly and monthly reports. Developed and designed workflows as well as integrating between systems for smooth and optimized operation of systems. All the iterative development lifecycles were followed in Agile methodology. Created Connect - and Service - rules to expose data to other systems through SOAP and web services by integration rules. Created stream and parse rules to generate XML stream flow into an external system and receive Implemented and deployed Java Messaging Services and Message Driven Beans to connect and communicate with external systems through internally auto-generated messages. CPM Card framework has been used in Card Disputes project in building claims work flows. Used Smart Adjust frame work in Pega Cards to automate the payment process and handle the dispute management work flows. Implementation of Decision tables, Decision Maps and Declarative expressions for validations. Developed technical requirements to provide end state requirements for line of business and development team. Led the upgrade version project in PRPC from 5.5 to 6.1 in Citicards application. Developed artifacts and workflows while following company standards and guidelines. Prepared Unit test cases and Unit test logs. Created the Connect rules and data-mapping to connect to the external RDB. Created list and summary view reports and provided access groups to enable security on them. Environment: Pega PRPC 5.5, CPC HC Framework, Oracle 9i, Tomcat 4.1, Java, JSP, Windows 2000 professional, HTML, SOAPUI, XMLspy.

Performed correspondence to intimate the customers about their offer status through email or fax messages. Involved in Change management aspects which include defining and implementing the procedures/technologies to deal with changes in business environment.
